title_text: I test software from the UI to the database.
body_text: I automate web, API, database and mobile checks, then run them in CI. When one fails, I trace the failure before deciding whether the test or the product needs fixing.

title_text: I test the whole checkout flow.
body_text: For this demo, I follow a checkout through the browser, API, database, webhook and notification, and verify the result at each step.
